data.narrative:
Newspace Research is a Series B-stage company in Defense & Security that has raised $73.2M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable set of 8 private peers at the same stage and 2 public defense contractors, representing a reasonably populated sector cohort.

Two triangulation methods were applied. The stage-progression method uses total capital raised as a valuation proxy and applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement, yielding $139M. The peer-median method references 8 same-sector, same-stage private companies ranging from $300M to $3.0B in valuation, with a median of $1.1B. The peer sample includes Dream Security ($3.0B), Allen Control Systems ($2.2B), Harmattan AI ($1.4B), Code Metal ($1.2B), and Twenty ($1.0B).

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $118M (low) to $1.3B (high), with a median implied value of $632M. The wide dispersion reflects genuine heterogeneity within the Defense & Security peer set; Dream Security and Allen Control Systems command 2-3x the peer median, while smaller entrants sit closer to the $300M floor. Key uncertainties include Newspace Research's relative technical maturity, revenue traction, customer concentration, and regulatory pathway—factors that explain why identically-staged peers trade at such different multiples of capital deployed.
